key_insight: Jianmu-Q uses coordinated AI agents to convert natural-language quantum field theory descriptions into validated quantum simulation workflows spanning theory, discretization, qubit mapping, and circuit design.
engineering_relevance: The framework lowers the translation burden between continuum physics and quantum hardware, making end-to-end simulation pipelines for hard field theories more practical and reproducible.
method: Specialized agents perform theory formulation, lattice discretization, qubit mapping, and circuit synthesis.
Physical-consistency checks and independent numerical calculations validate each stage of the workflow.
Selected circuits are run on IBM quantum hardware after noiseless simulation benchmarking.
evidence_signal: The framework is benchmarked on three field theories of increasing complexity, and noiseless quantum-circuit simulations converge toward independent exact-diagonalization and tensor-network results, with selected circuits also executed on IBM hardware.
watch_item: Performance depends on correct agent coordination and validation; scaling to larger, noisier hardware or more complex field theories may introduce substantial overhead and error sensitivity.
paper_title: Jianmu-Q: Bridging Quantum Field Theory and Quantum Hardware with AI Agents
